s1.desc: an office of grey filing cabinets drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a living room with a cream sofa, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: 10 locked frames (ECC scale 1.0000 f1-9): Polly stands among the filing cabinets holding a sheet of paper up to her face. The pull-back starts at f10

spans.view: with stacks of papers piled on top of the cabinets and open drawers

beats.text: Polly stands between the filing cabinets holding a sheet of paper up to her face, reading it
Polly flings her flippers up again and again, tossing papers into the air with an open beak
Polly ducks down with her eyes squeezed shut as the papers flutter around her
Polly pops back up and hurries off to the right with her flippers out

spans.notes: steady pull-back with a slight drift down-right, ECC on the cabinet bodies (y 0.42-0.62, x 0-0.3): scale 0.9998 f10, 0.9936 f16, 0.9853 f21, 0.9748 f29; on the cabinet tops 0.9654 f32 -> 0.9449 f40 (cc >= 0.98). Ends at f39, where papers carried by a second Polly come in at the left edge (her body from f42)

copies of Polly: a second identical Polly comes in from the left (papers f39, body f42; two on screen together f44), more Pollys from ~f58 (three or four rushing about f84-100) while the pull-back continues (ECC scale 0.93 f44 -> 0.65 f92 vs f0) and filing cabinets slide into the foreground f100-111

18 frames, also camera_move: hard cut to Polly's face filling the picture, then a fast ease-out pull-back to her sitting on the sofa (ECC vs f130: scale 1.127 f122, 1.043 f125, 1.006 f128, 0.998 f129), locked from f130

spans.view: with a peach cushion behind her and a yellow shell-shaped cushion at the sofa's arm

beats.text: Polly sits back against a cushion on the sofa holding {ifin} up in front of her, gazing at it and blinking
Polly taps at the phone's screen with her other flipper, watching it closely
Polly squeezes her eyes shut and laughs with an open beak, her flipper raised beside the phone
Polly opens her eyes and goes back to tapping at the phone, smiling
Polly tips her head back with her eyes closed, laughing with an open beak as she hugs the phone to her chest

spans.notes: ECC on the sofa front and floor shadow (y 0.66-0.92) vs f130: scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 through f218; compare 130/225 sofa edges black. Phone has the pale grey back, three lenses and tuft = iFin; its screen faces away from us
